title: MACHEREY-NAGEL NucleoMag® RNA Protocol
author: MACHEREY-NAGEL
materials: Download your protocol and unzip if needed.

steps.title: Prepare samples and deck
steps.instruction: Perform the lysis according to the NucleoMag® RNA user manual, prepare the rDNase reaction mixture as described in the manual, fill the 12‑well buffer reservoir (see the protocol table), vortex‑resuspend the NucleoMag B‑Beads and place them in Position A1 of the 2 mL tube rack, load the instrument deck according to the displayed positions, and place the square‑well block containing the lysates on the magnetic module before starting the run.

substeps.instruction: Perform lysis per NucleoMag® RNA user manual.
Prepare rDNase reaction mixture per user manual.
Fill the 12‑well buffer reservoir as specified.
Resuspend NucleoMag B‑Beads by vortexing and place in Position A1 of the 2 mL tube rack.
Load the OT‑2 deck according to the displayed positions.
Place the square‑well block with lysates on the magnetic module and start the run.

steps.title: Upload protocol files
steps.instruction: Download the protocol zip file, unzip if needed, upload any custom labware JSON files via OT App > More > Custom Labware > Add Labware, and upload the .py protocol file in the Protocol tab.

substeps.instruction: Download and unzip the protocol package.
Upload custom labware JSON files (if required).
Upload the .py protocol file to the OT App Protocol tab.

steps.title: Set up deck
steps.instruction: Arrange all labware on the OT‑2 deck exactly as shown in the provided deck map.

steps.title: Calibrate equipment
steps.instruction: Calibrate the labware, tip racks, and pipette using the OT App calibration workflow.

steps.title: Run OT‑2 protocol
steps.instruction: Start the OT‑2 run, which will automatically perform the Binding step, rDNase digestion, three wash steps, and the Elution step as programmed. Refer to the full workflow description at the provided link if needed.

steps.title: Finalize run
steps.instruction: Press “Run” in the OT App to execute the protocol.
